programs.title: Air Crash Investigation
programs.desc: While landing in Düsseldorf, the turboprop flying Nürnberger Flugdienst 108 crashes. Everyone on board is killed.As part of the investigation, elements of the wreck from the disaster area should be secured.The experts face a real challenge - they must reconstruct the entire machine to determine the causes of the tragedy.The discovery of evidence of a lightning strike is a breakthrough in the case.It turns out that the discharge damaged the electrical system, which resulted in a loss of power.

programs.title: Car SOS
programs.desc: Tim Shaw and Fuzz Townshend take on new classics to restore them to their former glory.Renovations are carried out secretly from the owners.The team will have to deal with rust, broken engines, and obtain hard-to-find parts.This time he will deal with, among others:a small roadster that has not been used for half a century, will modernize the iconic hot hatch and save the movie star.There will be no shortage of unusual modifications and visits from stars.Experts will take care of a motorcycle for the first time and set out to retrieve a rescue off-road vehicle.
